recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **Hawkins Night Ride**, a mobile portrait browser survival game inspired by Stranger Things sci-fi horror adventure with small-town mystery, 80s nostalgia, supernatural portals, bike-riding teens, synth dread, friendship-driven quests, shadow-monster suspense, and mobile-first portrait controls.

Use a single self-contained HTML canvas implementation. Preserve the mechanic truth: drag anywhere on the gameplay canvas to move a top-down player, survive as long as possible, stay near a trailing friendly light/radio companion to replenish a meter, lose meter while away from safety, periodically spawn a pursuing shadow hazard, take meter damage on contact, and fail/restart when the meter reaches zero.

Present it as an authored 1980s small-town sci-fi horror adventure: a neon bike-riding teen, a glowing walkie/radio friend, suburban road tiles, house silhouettes, cyan friendship radio waves, red supernatural portal cracks, CRT scanlines, synth-dread audio, compact feedback GIFs, and clear mobile HUD copy.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint — Source Truth and Rebuilt Target

## Source identity observed
The preserved source (`index_old.html`) is a browser canvas survival game. The player drags to move a hero around an infinite top-down field. A friendly glowing entity follows and creates a safe radius. The meter regenerates near the friend and drains away from it. A hostile chaser periodically spawns at distance, pursues the hero, damages the meter on contact, and despawns/re-cools. Score is survival time. Failure occurs when the meter reaches zero; restart resets the state.

## Protected mechanics
- Drag/mouse/touch virtual joystick input on the canvas only.
- Continuous requestAnimationFrame update/draw loop.
- Hero speed 220, companion speed 190, chaser speed 260, light radius 180, dark drain 8, light regen 15, spawn cadence 10.
- Camera follow, timed score, meter HUD updates, collision/contact at approximately 40px, failure at zero meter, restart reset.

## Rebuilt target
`index.html` is rebuilt as **Hawkins Night Ride**, a portrait-first 80s sci-fi horror survival ride: a teen on a bike keeps a radio friendship link alive while a supernatural rift stalker hunts through a small-town neighborhood.

## Safe theming surfaces
All copy, HUD naming, procedural drawing, palette, particles, background motifs, audio mapping, GIF feedback, and menu presentation are transformed. Core control, movement, collision, scoring, drain/regen, spawn, and fail/restart semantics remain protected.
